scores.rationale: Pinned provenance and minimal integration are strongly established: HEAD and both fingerprints exactly match the binding, tracked status is clean, the pre-holdout structure test passes, and the contract records canonical surfaces, donor accounting, and anti-wholesale-integration constraints in .agents/evals/knowledge-composite-integration.json.

Exact knowledge graph and no-loss controls are adversarially supported by the passing 64-record Wiki health check with 64/64 root reachability, exact-set and graph-drift tests in scripts/tests/knowledge-composite-evals.test.mjs, and the reported complete family and composite mutation results.

Agency and collective-credit integrity is explicit and usable: apps/www/src/content/work/nyc-artist-coalition.mdx makes Jamie's supported actions visible while separating coalition, legislative, agency, and historical outcomes, and the tests cover missing classification, sole causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, and endorsement drift.

New-operator lifecycle commands are represented as thin canonical-workflow tools with non-promotion, unsafe-input, broken-graph, unknown-reference, and compiled-leak controls; their required operator surfaces are pinned by the contract and exercised by the composite test suite.

Survivorship, rights, and research re-entry remain correctly separated: the evidence preserves bounded absence language, keeps rights and consent distinct from factual support, retains an explicit rights hold, and mutation tests reject historical-absence overclaim, rights collapse, and automatic maturation of research leads.

Selective public composition and mosaic privacy are strongly controlled: docs/evals/composition-manifest.json governs route purpose, selected claims, budgets, and omissions, while docs/evals/mosaic-privacy-review.json identifies cross-fragment risks and continuing holds; composition mutations cover route loss, projection drift, selector binding, and budget counting.

Evaluator trust, calibration, and unchanged-candidate holdout requirements are met at the receipt level: this judge is independent, did not author the patch or inspect optimization history, and verified the exact SHA and fingerprints. Per the frozen contract, only the aggregate may derive a 4 after validating both unseen independent receipts.

Layered verification and release policy are code-review ready: the pre-holdout structure, public-safety, route, and Wiki-health layers pass, and docs/production-readiness.md plus docs/deployment.md correctly separate staging noindex, later full check/build/runtime verification, application QA, production cutover, and indexing. A 4 is withheld because the stated later full repository check and build are not evidence from this holdout call.

Truthful human and consent gates are fully preserved: PR-019, PR-025, rights and collaborator consent, Jamie's production approval, cutover, and indexing remain pending human decisions rather than automated approvals. This blocks application sharing or launch, not code-review readiness.
